title: Qersh for WooCommerce configuration
description: The JSON of the qersh_wc_config option, of the settings export and import, and of the QERSH_WC_CONFIG constant in wp-config.php (docs/17 §4.2 in the Qersh repository). tolerance_sec, matching and dedup are taken from the core's receiver schema (urn:qersh:receiver-config:1, vendored as fixtures/qersh.config.schema.json) by JSON pointer, so load both schemas into your validator. Connection keys never belong here: they are stored per wallet, or given as QERSH_WC_KEY_<WALLET ID> constants. Omitted parts take the defaults shown. The plugin ignores unknown fields; this schema refuses them to catch typos.

receiver.description: The names of the core's QershReceiverConfig, without keys.

path.description: Fixed: the REST route is registered at this path, relative to the REST root, and the wallet id is appended (qersh/v1/webhook/<id>).

events.description: The events the plugin handles; any other event with a valid signature is answered 2xx ignored. transfer.received is required.

matching.description: The core's matching windows. The plugin's default skew_min is 0 (the owner's decision: an order created after the money arrived is never matched automatically); the core's is 10.

wallets.description: The store's receiving wallets. Ids are unique, and the id of a deleted wallet cannot be reused (restore the wallet instead).

order_ttl_min.description: Minutes the customer has to transfer; the order is cancelled at this deadline plus receiver.matching.late_window_min.

min_total_minor.description: Smallest order total, in piasters, for which the method is offered; null for no limit. Not more than max_total_minor.

max_total_minor.description: Largest order total, in piasters, for which the method is offered; null for no limit.

round_up_to_pound.description: Accept a whole-pound transfer for a total with piasters (*9# transfers carry no piasters).

allow_key_link.description: Offer "your developer's link with the connection key" on the wallet card.

txn_entry.description: Show the transaction id box on the order page of Orange Cash orders.

admin_cancel_email_on_expiry.description: The switch for WooCommerce's "Cancelled order" email to the administrator when the deadline alone cancels an order (docs/17 §4.2 and §4.7); every other cancellation keeps the email.

unmatched_retention_days.description: Days after which transfers that matched no order are deleted.

remove_data_on_uninstall.description: Delete the plugin's tables, settings and connection keys when the plugin is deleted. QERSH_WC_REMOVE_ALL_DATA overrides it.

id.description: Generated by the store when the wallet is added; part of the webhook URL.

receive_address.description: Where customers transfer to: an 11-digit wallet number, or name@instapay for instapay_app. The plugin also accepts other spellings (+20…, spaces, Arabic digits) and stores them normalised; this schema asks for the normalised form.
